svg.text: A kawaii field guide to inter-universal Teichmüller theory, part 2. The first infographic said what each Hodge theater is; this one builds them, square by square, the way the toolkit does it for abc(1,2400,2401) (l = 13, |V| = 6). Every square below is a real process:

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: it ran, it printed => ok, and its numbers are what it printed. Then each type gets a card with its recipe, one fact to remember, and three jokes from Japanese pop culture. The mochi are original. The jokes are text-only references.
